Offline English voice recognition

Vosk-browser 0.0.8 (Apache-2.0)
Published package: https://www.npmjs.com/package/vosk-browser
Source project: https://github.com/ccoreilly/vosk-browser
Runtime download: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/vosk-browser@0.0.8/dist/vosk.js

English small model: vosk-model-small-en-us-0.15 (Apache-2.0)
Model project and license information: https://alphacephei.com/vosk/models
Browser archive: https://ccoreilly.github.io/vosk-browser/models/vosk-model-small-en-us-0.15.tar.gz

Vosk speech engine: https://github.com/alphacep/vosk-api (Apache-2.0)
License: https://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0

Audio is processed locally in a browser worker when Offline English is selected.
No speech-service API key or internet connection is required for the bundled model.
Refresh downloads, if needed, with: node get-voice-model.js
